text: If I tell you to leave me alone, and you leave me alone, you're legit dead to me. This is a crazy one. She literally says, if I tell you to leave me alone, and you actually leave me alone, you are dead to me. Like, what do you want then? A man who reads minds or can see the future? If a woman says, leave me alone, and then gets mad when you do, that's not femininity, that's emotional chaos. You can't build a relationship on that. So guys, don't fall for that trap. When a woman says something, believe her. If she says she needs some time off or some space, give her that space. If she says she's done, let her be done. Don't chase, don't beg, don't text, just to check in. If you gave her that space and let her be done, stay on that, and don't come back if she changed her mind. Because if she's testing you like that, she's not looking for a relationship, she's looking for control. And you will never win that game. The right woman won't confuse you. She'll make you feel calm and peaceful, not crazy. So yeah, if she tells you to leave her alone, do exactly that. And stay gone.
